title: One Step Behind
setup: Your rook on c1 eyes the bishop on c5, and the knight on e6 is the only thing keeping it alive.
hint: The target is defended once. Look at that single defender and ask which of your pieces can reach it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxe6}} takes the knight guarding c5. After {{fxe6}} the bishop is loose and {{Rxc5}} collects it. Bishop for knight is a fair trade — the bishop on c5 is the bonus. One even trade can uncover a whole free piece.
